title: Full-Length Mock Test 10 — Maths & Science (Telugu L1)

questions.question: Which is a fair way to support a learner who needs more time?
options: Provide an appropriate time accommodation when warranted
Lower every learning goal without review
Announce the learner's difficulty to everyone
questions.explanation: Reasonable accommodations can improve access while preserving the intended construct where appropriate.

questions.question: Open-ended questions are useful because they can:
questions.explanation: Open-ended questions can elicit explanation, interpretation and diverse justified responses.

questions.question: Which strategy is interleaving?
options: Mix different but related problem types during practice
Practise one problem type exclusively every time
questions.explanation: Interleaving mixes problem types so learners practise identifying which approach fits.

questions.question: Which classroom routine can help learners organize new information?
options: Use concept maps to show relationships
questions.explanation: Concept maps make relationships among ideas more visible.

questions.question: Which response best reinforces a classroom expectation?
options: Acknowledge the specific behaviour that met the expectation
Compare the learner with a classmate
Ignore the behaviour and criticize later
questions.explanation: Specific acknowledgement makes the expected behaviour clear.

questions.question: Peer learning is effective when:
options: Learners have clear roles and a shared learning goal
One learner does all the work
questions.explanation: Structured collaboration encourages participation and keeps the group focused on learning.

questions.question: When reinforcement for a previously reinforced behaviour stops and the behaviour declines, this is:
questions.explanation: Extinction occurs when reinforcement is discontinued and the behaviour decreases.

questions.question: Which statement about learner agency is appropriate?
options: Learners can make meaningful choices within clear, supportive boundaries
Agency means no guidance or structure
Learners should never reflect on choices
Only adults may set any learning goal
questions.explanation: Agency involves supported participation and choice, not the absence of structure or guidance.

questions.question: Which practice best combines challenge with support?
options: Provide a demanding task with scaffolds matched to current needs
Give an impossible task without guidance
questions.explanation: Appropriate scaffolding can help learners engage with challenging work.

questions.question: Which is an example of meaningful learning?
options: Connecting a new concept with prior knowledge
questions.explanation: Meaningful learning links new information to relevant concepts already understood.

questions.question: A lesson plan should include assessment because it helps the teacher:
options: Check whether intended learning is occurring
Ensure every learner gets the same score
questions.explanation: Assessment evidence helps teachers judge progress and adjust instruction.

questions.question: A teacher provides enlarged print to a learner with low vision. This is an example of:
questions.explanation: Accessible materials can remove barriers without changing the learning goal.

questions.question: A teacher wants to understand repeated off-task behaviour. Which is a useful first step?
options: Look for patterns, triggers and task-related barriers
Assume the learner is intentionally disrespectful
questions.explanation: Examining patterns and context can help identify factors contributing to behaviour.

questions.question: Which is a useful way to involve learners in goal-setting?
options: Discuss achievable next steps based on evidence and learner input
questions.explanation: Learner involvement and evidence-based next steps can make goals meaningful and actionable.

questions.question: A teacher responds to misbehaviour by calmly restating the expectation and offering a choice. This is:
questions.explanation: Calm redirection maintains expectations while helping the learner return to the task.

questions.question: Which response is most appropriate for minor disruption when safe to do so?
options: Use a calm, proportionate reminder and redirect to the task
questions.explanation: A calm and proportionate redirection can address minor disruption while preserving dignity.

questions.question: Which approach avoids stereotyping learners from a cultural group?
options: Ask open questions and respond to each learner’s actual experiences
Assume group membership predicts every preference
Ask one learner to represent an entire culture
Use fixed expectations based on identity
questions.explanation: Open inquiry and individual responsiveness avoid treating group identity as a complete description.

questions.question: Which practice encourages respectful disagreement?
options: Ask learners to critique ideas with reasons rather than attack people
questions.explanation: Focusing on ideas and evidence allows disagreement while protecting respectful participation.

questions.question: Which is an example of a protective classroom climate?
options: Respectful relationships and predictable, fair expectations
questions.explanation: A supportive climate combines respect, safety and consistent expectations.

questions.question: Which principle is central to universal design for learning?
options: Provide multiple means of engagement, representation, and action or expression
Use one format for every learner
questions.explanation: Universal Design for Learning plans flexible access and participation from the outset.

questions.question: Which strategy can support attention and engagement?
options: Use purposeful variation, interaction and suitable challenge
questions.explanation: Purposeful variation and suitable challenge can help sustain engagement.

questions.question: A child learns to tie shoelaces through repeated practice. This is an example of:
questions.explanation: Repeated practice can support the acquisition of a practical skill.

questions.question: Which is a useful first step when a learner repeatedly misses instructions?
options: Check access, clarity, attention and understanding before choosing a response
Increase the length of every instruction
questions.explanation: Investigating why instructions are missed helps identify an appropriate and effective support.

questions.question: Action research in a classroom involves:
options: Systematically investigating a teaching issue to improve practice
questions.explanation: Action research uses systematic inquiry to understand and improve classroom practice.

questions.question: A teacher offers text, diagrams and a demonstration to teach a process. This provides multiple means of:
questions.explanation: Different representations can help learners perceive and understand information.

questions.question: A summative assessment is commonly used to:
options: Evaluate achievement at the end of a learning period
questions.explanation: Summative assessment evaluates learning after a unit, course or other period.

questions.question: A learner studies because the topic is interesting and satisfying. This is:
questions.explanation: Intrinsic motivation arises from interest or satisfaction within the activity itself.

questions.question: A diagnostic test is most useful when its results are used to:
options: Identify starting points and plan suitable instruction
questions.explanation: Diagnostic evidence should inform planning and support rather than become a fixed label.

questions.question: Which statement about play in childhood is most accurate?
options: Play can support cognitive, social, language and emotional development
Play is useful only after formal instruction
questions.explanation: Play offers opportunities to explore, communicate, solve problems and practise social skills.

questions.question: A scoring rubric improves consistency when it:
options: Describes criteria and levels of performance clearly
Changes standards for each learner without explanation
questions.explanation: Clear criteria and performance descriptions help make scoring more transparent and consistent.

questions.question: భాషా అభ్యసనంలో విద్యార్థుల స్వంత రచనలను ప్రదర్శించడం?
questions.explanation: విద్యార్థుల రచనలను పంచుకోవడం రచనకు నిజమైన పాఠకులను, ప్రేరణను అందిస్తుంది.

questions.question: వాస్తవం, అభిప్రాయాన్ని వేరు చేయడానికి ఏ ప్రశ్న అడగాలి?
questions.explanation: సరైన సమాధానం: దీనిని నిర్ధారించే ఆధారం ఉందా?. ప్రశ్నలో సూచించిన భాషా లేదా అభ్యసన చర్యకు ఈ అంశమే నేరుగా సంబంధించినది.

questions.question: చదివిన పాఠ్యానికి సంబంధించిన కొత్త ప్రశ్నను రూపొందించి దానికి సమాధానం వెతకడం ఏది?
questions.explanation: కొత్త ప్రశ్నను రూపొందించి సమాధానం వెతకడం చురుకైన పఠనాన్ని ప్రోత్సహిస్తుంది.

questions.question: ‘విలక్షణం’కు సమీపార్థం ఏది?
questions.explanation: విలక్షణం అంటే ప్రత్యేకమైన లేదా ఇతరులకంటే భిన్నమైనది.

questions.question: పిల్లలు కొత్తగా నేర్చుకున్న పదాన్ని రోజువారీ సంభాషణలో ప్రయోగించడం?
questions.explanation: తరగతి వెలుపల పదాన్ని ఉపయోగించడం నేర్చుకున్న భాషను నిజజీవితానికి బదిలీ చేయడం.

questions.question: ‘అందం’కు పర్యాయపదం ఏది?
questions.explanation: సౌందర్యం అందాన్ని సూచిస్తుంది.

questions.question: ‘పిల్లవాడు’ పదంలో మూలపదం ఏది?
questions.explanation: సరైన సమాధానం: పిల్ల. ప్రశ్నలో పేర్కొన్న భాషా లక్షణం లేదా బోధనా చర్యకు ఇది సరిపడే వివరణ.

questions.question: ముసాయిదాలో భావాల క్రమాన్ని మార్చి రచనను మరింత స్పష్టంగా చేయడం?
questions.explanation: భావాల క్రమాన్ని మార్చడం రచన పునర్విమర్శలోని పునర్వ్యవస్థీకరణ చర్య.

questions.question: పద్యంలోని లయను గట్టిగా చదివి గుర్తించడం ఏ అంశానికి తోడ్పడుతుంది?
options: పాఠ్యంతో సంబంధం లేని వ్యక్తిగత ఊహను చెప్పడం
questions.explanation: సరైన సమాధానం: ఛందో, శ్రవణ అనుభూతి. ఈ ఎంపిక ప్రశ్నలో సూచించిన భాషా నైపుణ్యం లేదా బోధనా లక్ష్యాన్ని నేరుగా వివరిస్తుంది.

questions.question: ‘కష్టపడితే ఫలితం’ అనే భావం ఏ ప్రక్రియకు దగ్గరగా ఉంటుంది?
questions.explanation: సరైన సమాధానం: కారణ–ఫలిత సంబంధం. ప్రశ్నలో పేర్కొన్న భాషా లక్షణం లేదా బోధనా చర్యకు ఇది సరిపడే వివరణ.

questions.question: పాఠ్యాన్ని త్వరగా చదివి మొత్తం భావాన్ని తెలుసుకోవడం ఏ పద్ధతి?
questions.explanation: స్కిమ్మింగ్ ద్వారా పాఠ్య సమగ్ర భావాన్ని త్వరగా గ్రహిస్తారు.

questions.question: విద్యార్థి చదివిన పాఠ్యంపై తన అవగాహనను గ్రాఫిక్ ఆర్గనైజర్‌లో చూపడం ఏది?
questions.explanation: గ్రాఫిక్ ఆర్గనైజర్ భావాలు, సంబంధాలను దృశ్యరూపంలో క్రమబద్ధీకరిస్తుంది.

questions.question: ముగింపు మూల్యాంకనం ప్రధానంగా ఏమి తెలియజేస్తుంది?
options: ఒక దశ చివర సాధించిన అభ్యసన స్థాయి
questions.explanation: సరైన సమాధానం: ఒక దశ చివర సాధించిన అభ్యసన స్థాయి. ప్రశ్నలో సూచించిన భాషా లేదా అభ్యసన చర్యకు ఈ అంశమే నేరుగా సంబంధించినది.

questions.question: అనుభవ కథనంలో మొదటి వ్యక్తి వాడకం ఏ ప్రభావాన్ని కలిగిస్తుంది?
questions.explanation: సరైన సమాధానం: వ్యక్తిగత అనుభవ దృక్కోణాన్ని అందిస్తుంది. ప్రశ్నలో పేర్కొన్న భాషా లేదా బోధనా సందర్భానికి ఈ సమాధానం సరిపోతుంది.

questions.question: ఒక కవితలో ధ్వని పునరావృతిని గుర్తించడం ఏ అంశాన్ని పరిశీలిస్తుంది?
questions.explanation: సరైన సమాధానం: శబ్ద సౌందర్యం. ప్రశ్నలో సూచించిన భాషా లేదా అభ్యసన చర్యకు ఈ అంశమే నేరుగా సంబంధించినది.

questions.question: విద్యార్థుల ఉచ్చారణను మెరుగుపరచడానికి ఉపయోగకరమైన సాధన ఏది?
questions.explanation: మంచి నమూనాను విని సాధన చేయడం ఉచ్చారణ, ధ్వని స్పష్టతను మెరుగుపరచడంలో తోడ్పడుతుంది.

questions.question: విద్యార్థి కథలోని సంఘటనలను సరైన క్రమంలో అమర్చడం ఏ అవగాహనను సూచిస్తుంది?
questions.explanation: సంఘటనలను క్రమపరచడం కథా క్రమాన్ని అర్థం చేసుకున్నాడో చూపిస్తుంది.

questions.question: భాషా అభ్యసనంలో నిజజీవిత పత్రాలు వాడటం వల్ల?
questions.explanation: సరైన సమాధానం: ప్రామాణిక భాషా వినియోగ పరిచయం. ప్రశ్నలో పేర్కొన్న భాషా లక్షణం లేదా బోధనా చర్యకు ఇది సరిపడే వివరణ.

questions.question: పాఠ్యానికి సంబంధించిన భావాన్ని వాస్తవ జీవిత సమస్యకు వర్తింపజేయడం ఏది?
questions.explanation: పాఠ్య భావాన్ని కొత్త లేదా వాస్తవ సందర్భంలో ఉపయోగించడం అన్వయం.

questions.question: పఠనానంతరం విద్యార్థులు పాఠంలోని భావాలను భావపటం రూపంలో చూపితే?
questions.explanation: భావపటం ప్రధాన భావాలు, ఉపభావాలు, వాటి సంబంధాలను దృశ్యంగా క్రమపరుస్తుంది.

questions.question: ‘విజయం’కు వ్యతిరేకార్థక పదం ఏది?
questions.explanation: సరైన సమాధానం: పరాజయం. ప్రశ్నలో పేర్కొన్న భాషా లేదా బోధనా సందర్భానికి ఈ సమాధానం సరిపోతుంది.

questions.question: విద్యార్థుల స్థాయిలకు అనుగుణంగా పాఠ్య భాగాలు ఇవ్వడం?
questions.explanation: సరైన సమాధానం: భిన్న అవసరాలకు తగిన అభ్యసన మద్దతు. ప్రశ్నలో సూచించిన భాషా లేదా అభ్యసన చర్యకు ఈ అంశమే నేరుగా సంబంధించినది.

questions.question: ‘ద్వారం మూసివేయండి’ ఏ వాక్య రకం?
questions.explanation: ‘మూసివేయండి’ ఆదేశం లేదా సూచనను తెలియజేస్తుంది.

questions.question: ‘వారు నిన్న వచ్చారు’లో భూతకాల సూచన ఏది?
questions.explanation: ‘వచ్చారు’ గతంలో జరిగిన చర్యను సూచించే క్రియారూపం.

questions.question: విద్యార్థి ఒక పాఠ్యంలోని ముఖ్యమైన పదాన్ని ఎంచుకుని అది భావాన్ని ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేసిందో వివరించడం ఏది?
questions.explanation: పదం భావంపై చూపే ప్రభావాన్ని వివరించడం భాషా విశ్లేషణలో భాగం.

questions.question: భాషా తరగతిలో ఉదాహరణలను విద్యార్థుల పరిచిత పరిసరాల నుంచి తీసుకోవడం ఏది సాధిస్తుంది?
questions.explanation: పరిచిత సందర్భాలు కొత్త భాషా భావాలను అర్థం చేసుకోవడానికి వంతెనగా పనిచేస్తాయి.

questions.question: పోర్ట్‌ఫోలియోలో పని ఎంపికకు కారణం రాయడం ఏది పెంచుతుంది?
questions.explanation: సరైన సమాధానం: స్వీయ ప్రతిబింబం. పాఠ్యాన్ని పరిశీలించి, సంబంధిత ఆధారంతో భావాన్ని వివరించడం ఈ నైపుణ్యానికి కేంద్రం.

questions.question: ‘పక్షులు ఆకాశంలో ఎగురుతున్నాయి’లో కర్త ఏది?
questions.explanation: ఎగురుతున్నవి పక్షులు; కాబట్టి అవే కర్త.

questions.question: రచనలో మొదట ఆలోచనలను స్వేచ్ఛగా నమోదు చేసి తరువాత వర్గీకరించడం ఏ పద్ధతి?
questions.explanation: ముసాయిదాకు ముందు ఆలోచనలను సేకరించడం రచన ప్రణాళికలో ఉపయోగపడుతుంది.

questions.question: అనుచ్ఛేదంలో మొదటి వాక్యం ప్రధాన భావాన్ని పరిచయం చేస్తే దాన్ని ఏమంటారు?
questions.explanation: సరైన సమాధానం: విషయ వాక్యం. ప్రశ్నలో పేర్కొన్న భాషా లక్షణం లేదా బోధనా చర్యకు ఇది సరిపడే వివరణ.

questions.question: Choose the correct article: He hopes to become ___ engineer.
questions.explanation: 'Engineer' begins with a vowel sound, requiring 'an'.

questions.question: Which sentence contains an appositive?
options: My friend, a skilled violinist, performed tonight.
My friend performed tonight because she practised.
My friend who performed tonight is skilled.
My friend performed and then left.
questions.explanation: 'A skilled violinist' renames and identifies 'my friend'.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: I wish I ___ speak French fluently.
questions.explanation: 'Could' expresses a wished-for ability in the present.

questions.question: Which statement describes reliability in assessment?
options: The results are reasonably consistent across comparable occasions or raters
The test measures exactly the intended construct
The test is enjoyable for every learner
The test contains a large number of pages
questions.explanation: Reliability concerns consistency of measurement.

questions.question: Choose the correct option: The manager asked whether I ___ the report.
questions.explanation: In reported speech with a past reporting verb, the present perfect commonly backshifts to past perfect.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The medicine had an immediate ___.
questions.explanation: 'Effect' is a noun meaning a result or consequence.

questions.question: What does 'beat around the bush' mean?
options: Avoid addressing the main point directly
questions.explanation: The idiom means avoid saying something directly.

questions.question: Choose the synonym of 'diligent'.
questions.explanation: 'Diligent' means showing careful and persistent effort.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: Not only ___ the answer, but she also explained it.
questions.explanation: When 'not only' begins the clause, subject-auxiliary inversion is used.

questions.question: Which activity is proofreading?
options: Check the final draft for spelling, punctuation and typographical errors
Choose a topic for an essay
questions.explanation: Proofreading focuses on surface-level errors in a near-final text.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The medicine may ___ drowsiness.
questions.explanation: 'Cause' means bring about.

questions.question: Choose the correct option: She plays ___ violin in the school orchestra.
questions.explanation: Musical instruments commonly take 'the' with 'play'.

questions.question: Which sentence contains an infinitive of purpose?
options: He went to the library to borrow a book.
questions.explanation: 'To borrow a book' explains the purpose of going to the library.

questions.question: Choose the correct option: ___ you mind opening the window?
questions.explanation: 'Would you mind...?' is a polite request pattern.

questions.question: Choose the correct question tag: They weren't late, ___?
questions.explanation: A negative statement takes a positive tag; the auxiliary is 'were'.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a semicolon correctly?
options: I wanted to go; however, it was too late.
I wanted; to go however it was too late.
I wanted to; go it was too late.
I wanted to go however; it was too late.
questions.explanation: A semicolon can join closely related independent clauses; 'however' is followed by a comma.

questions.question: Choose the correct tense: She usually ___ to school by bus.
questions.explanation: The simple present expresses a regular habit; 'she' takes 'goes'.

questions.question: Which strategy is most useful when a learner encounters an unfamiliar word while reading?
options: Use context clues and word parts before checking a dictionary
Assume the first guessed meaning is always correct
Stop reading and memorize the entire page
questions.explanation: Context and morphology can help infer meaning; a dictionary can then confirm it.

questions.question: Choose the correct option: The room ___ when we entered.
questions.explanation: The past continuous passive shows an action in progress at that past moment.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: This matter is different than that one in every formal context.
This matter is different from that one.
This matter differs than that one.
This matter is different to than that one.
questions.explanation: 'Different from' is a widely accepted standard construction.

questions.question: Choose the correct option: There is ___ sugar left, so we can make tea.
questions.explanation: 'Sugar' is uncountable; 'a little' means a small amount that is available.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The two proposals are quite ___.
questions.explanation: 'Different' is the adjective needed after 'are'.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: Please ___ your answer with evidence from the passage.
questions.explanation: 'Justify' is the verb meaning provide reasons or evidence for a claim.

questions.question: Which is the main purpose of revising a composition?
options: Change every noun to a pronoun
questions.explanation: Revision addresses content and structure to improve the text.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The instructions were stated with great ___.
questions.explanation: 'Precision' is the noun meaning exactness.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically parallel?
options: The course teaches learners to read, to write and to speak clearly.
The course teaches learners reading, to write and speaking clearly.
The course teaches learners to read, writing and to speak clearly.
The course teaches learners read, to writing and speak clearly.
questions.explanation: The three infinitive phrases have matching grammatical form.

questions.question: Which sentence contains a noun clause?
options: I believe that she is honest.
questions.explanation: 'That she is honest' functions as the object of 'believe'.

questions.question: Choose the correct modal: You ___ wear a helmet while riding a motorcycle; it is required by law.
questions.explanation: 'Must' expresses a strong obligation or requirement.

questions.question: Choose the correct option: The speaker answered the question ___.
questions.explanation: The adverb 'confidently' modifies the verb 'answered'.

questions.question: Which statement best describes diagnostic assessment?
options: It identifies learners' existing strengths and difficulties to inform instruction
It reports final achievement after a course
questions.explanation: Diagnostic assessment helps identify starting points and learning needs.

questions.question: If x + y = 15 and x = 9, find y.
A class has 18 girls and 12 boys. What fraction of the class are boys?
questions.explanation: There are 30 learners; the fraction who are boys is 12/30 = 2/5.

questions.question: Each interior angle of a regular hexagon is:
Which statement reflects a growth-oriented view of mathematical ability?
options: Only some children are born able to learn mathematics
Mistakes show a permanent lack of ability
Strategies and understanding can improve with effort and feedback
Speed is the only measure of mathematical competence
questions.explanation: A growth-oriented view emphasizes development through strategies, practice and useful feedback.

questions.question: If the perimeter of a square is 52 cm, its side length is:
questions.explanation: Side = 52/4 = 13 cm.

questions.question: An exterior angle of a triangle is 130°. One remote interior angle is 55°. Find the other.
questions.explanation: An exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles; 130° − 55° = 75°.

questions.question: A prism has 9 edges. Which prism could it be?
questions.explanation: A triangular prism has 9 edges.

questions.question: The sum of exterior angles, one at each vertex of any convex polygon, is:
questions.explanation: One full turn around the polygon totals 360°.

questions.question: A teacher uses bottle caps to introduce grouping and multiplication. This mainly supports:
questions.explanation: Manipulatives provide concrete experiences that can later be represented symbolically.

questions.question: Which number is divisible by 11?
questions.explanation: For 4,356, (4 + 5) − (3 + 6) = 0, so it is divisible by 11.

questions.question: A rectangle has area 144 cm² and length 16 cm. Its width is:
questions.explanation: Width = 144 ÷ 16 = 9 cm.

questions.question: Factorise: 6x + 12.
questions.explanation: The common factor is 6: 6x + 12 = 6(x + 2).

questions.question: A cone has radius 3 cm and height 4 cm. Its volume is:
questions.explanation: Volume = 1/3πr²h = 1/3 × π × 9 × 4 = 12π cm³.

questions.question: A bus has 48 seats, of which 36 are occupied. What percentage of seats are occupied?
Find the LCM of 18 and 24.
questions.explanation: The least common multiple is 72.

questions.question: The mean of 6, 8, 10 and 12 is:
questions.explanation: Their sum is 36; 36 divided by 4 is 9.

questions.question: A right triangle has legs 6 cm and 8 cm. Its hypotenuse is:
questions.explanation: By Pythagoras, c = √(36 + 64) = 10 cm.

questions.question: Which statement about the mean is correct?
options: It is always one of the observed values
It is calculated by dividing the sum by the number of values
It is always the middle value
It is the difference between extremes
questions.explanation: The arithmetic mean equals the total of the observations divided by their count.

questions.question: A tank is 3/4 full. After 18 litres are removed, it is half full. What is the tank capacity?
questions.explanation: The removed 18 L equals 1/4 of capacity; capacity = 72 L.

questions.question: Solve: 4(2x − 3) = 20.
questions.explanation: Divide by 4: 2x − 3 = 5; hence 2x = 8 and x = 4.

questions.question: The heating effect of current is the basis of an:
questions.explanation: An electric iron uses resistive heating to produce heat.

questions.question: The major greenhouse gas released by burning fossil fuels is:
questions.explanation: Combustion of carbon-based fuels releases carbon dioxide.

questions.question: Action and reaction forces act on:
options: The same body in the same direction
Different bodies in the same direction
questions.explanation: Newton's third-law force pair acts on two interacting bodies in opposite directions.

questions.question: A student records temperature every minute and plots it against time. The graph is useful for:
options: Showing how temperature changes over time
questions.explanation: A time-series graph reveals trends in measured temperature.

questions.question: Which separation method is suitable for obtaining salt from salt solution?
questions.explanation: Evaporating the solvent leaves dissolved salt behind.

questions.question: A practical worksheet should normally include:
options: Purpose, materials, steps, observation space and safety guidance
questions.explanation: These elements guide safe, purposeful practical work and evidence recording.

questions.question: Gravitational potential energy near Earth's surface is given by:
questions.explanation: For a height h near Earth, gravitational potential energy is mgh.

questions.question: The image formed on the retina is:
questions.explanation: The eye lens forms a real, inverted image on the retina; the brain interprets it.

questions.question: Which allotrope of carbon conducts electricity well?
questions.explanation: Graphite has delocalized electrons that can carry electrical charge.

questions.question: Which fuel is often described as a cleaner fossil fuel because it emits less particulate matter and sulphur dioxide than coal when burned?
questions.explanation: Natural gas generally burns with fewer particulates and less SO₂ than coal, though it still emits CO₂.

questions.question: In a science experiment, a control setup is used to:
options: Provide a comparison for interpreting the effect of a variable
questions.explanation: A control provides a baseline against which the experimental condition can be compared.

questions.question: A learner's claim is not supported by their data. The teacher should encourage them to:
options: Revise the claim or collect further evidence
Change recorded data to fit the claim
questions.explanation: Scientific claims should be aligned with evidence, and further testing may be warranted.

questions.question: Formative assessment in science is used mainly to:
options: Inform teaching and learning while they are in progress
questions.explanation: Formative assessment provides evidence for timely feedback and instructional adjustment.

questions.question: A learner claims that heavier objects always fall faster. The teacher should first:
options: Elicit the learner's reasoning and use a controlled investigation to examine the claim
Mark the claim correct without discussion
Ask learners to memorize a different claim
questions.explanation: Eliciting ideas and testing them fairly supports conceptual change.

questions.question: Which electromagnetic wave is commonly used for remote controls?
questions.explanation: Many household remote controls transmit signals using infrared radiation.

questions.question: Which is a fossil fuel?
questions.explanation: Coal forms from ancient organic matter over geological time.

questions.question: Latent heat is energy absorbed or released during:
options: A change of state without temperature change
questions.explanation: Latent heat is associated with phase change at constant temperature.

questions.question: A device that converts electrical energy into mechanical energy is an:
questions.explanation: An electric motor converts electrical energy into mechanical motion.

questions.question: An object continues in its state of rest or uniform straight-line motion unless acted on by a net external force. This is:
questions.explanation: This statement expresses Newton's first law of motion.

questions.question: Which task best assesses learners' ability to communicate a scientific investigation?
options: Present a question, method, data, conclusion and evidence-based limitations
questions.explanation: A structured report communicates the investigation and its evidential basis.

questions.question: Decomposers are ecologically important because they:
options: Recycle nutrients from dead organic matter
questions.explanation: Decomposers break down organic matter and return nutrients to ecosystems.

questions.question: Primary succession can begin on:
options: Bare rock with little or no soil
A mature forest with intact soil only
questions.explanation: Primary succession begins on surfaces where soil is absent or very poorly developed.

questions.question: After fertilization in a flowering plant, the ovule usually develops into a:
questions.explanation: The fertilized ovule develops into a seed.

questions.question: Which assessment is especially suitable for evaluating a student's practical skill?
options: A performance task with an observation rubric
questions.explanation: A practical task and rubric can directly assess technique, safety, observation and recording.

questions.question: A group of organisms of the same species living in an area is a:
questions.explanation: A population comprises members of one species in a particular area.

questions.question: Phloem is chiefly responsible for transporting:
questions.explanation: Phloem translocates sugars and other organic substances from source to sink.

questions.question: When collecting field data, students should record:
questions.explanation: Contextual field notes help make observations interpretable and reproducible.

questions.question: To teach food chains meaningfully, students could:
options: Construct chains from organisms in a familiar habitat and justify feeding links
Memorize arrows without discussing their meaning
Assume arrows point toward the food eaten
questions.explanation: Building locally grounded chains helps learners interpret arrows as energy transfer from food to consumer.

questions.question: Biodiversity refers to the variety of:
options: Life at genetic, species and ecosystem levels
questions.explanation: Biodiversity includes variation within species, between species and among ecosystems.

questions.question: Which classroom question promotes higher-order thinking about ecosystems?
options: How might removing a predator change several populations, and what evidence would test your prediction?
What is the spelling of ecosystem?
questions.explanation: The question asks learners to reason about interactions and propose evidence to evaluate a prediction.

questions.question: The gallbladder primarily:
questions.explanation: The gallbladder stores and concentrates bile between meals.

questions.question: In flowering plants, the ovary usually develops into the:
questions.explanation: The ovary typically matures into the fruit, while ovules become seeds.

questions.question: A prokaryotic cell typically lacks a:
questions.explanation: Prokaryotes do not have a membrane-enclosed nucleus; their DNA is in a nucleoid region.

questions.question: A biological drawing should generally include:
options: Clear outlines, appropriate labels and a stated magnification or scale when required
questions.explanation: Scientific drawings should be clear, accurate and labelled, with scale information when relevant.

questions.question: The nutrient most directly needed for tissue growth and repair is:
questions.explanation: Proteins supply amino acids needed to build and repair tissues and make many functional molecules.

questions.question: The muscle primarily responsible for quiet inhalation is the:
questions.explanation: Contraction of the diaphragm increases thoracic volume during inhalation.

questions.question: A teacher uses a simulation to demonstrate natural selection. Learners should also discuss:
options: Which aspects the model represents and which real-world factors it omits
That model results prove every detail of nature
questions.explanation: Discussing model assumptions and limitations helps learners interpret simulations critically.

questions.question: The deficiency disease associated with vitamin D deficiency in children is:
questions.explanation: Vitamin D deficiency can impair bone mineralization and cause rickets in children.

questions.question: In binomial nomenclature, the genus name begins with:
options: A lowercase letter in every format
questions.explanation: The genus is capitalized; the specific epithet is lowercase, and both are conventionally italicized when typed.

questions.question: Tuberculosis is caused by a:
questions.explanation: Tuberculosis is caused by bacteria in the Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex.
